rules.statement: A sub-lessee who has not a title independent of his lessee is bound by the decree, but ordinarily a tenant would not be bound by the decree unless he were a party to the case.
rules.supporting_quote: "One can conceive of a tenancy where the lessee of a house or of a set of rooms lets in some person into one room-such a person would be more or less his dependant. The term 'sub-lessee' must not mislead. It may mean that the lessee assigns all his rights on the lease. In that case the second lessee comes after the first lessee and derives his title through him, but what he has obtained is an assignment and his rights are independent of the lessee."
